{{Quote|Our old buddy Amazia-- Den-mother of the Black-Hole gang! I thought the Empire gunned down the lot of you, over Delphon way.|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 8">[[Star Wars (1977) 8|''Star Wars'' (1977) 8]]</ref>}}
The '''Black Hole Gang''', also known as the '''Black Hole Pirates''', was a gang of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the [[Delphon system/Legends|Delphon system]]. Originally founded by the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] criminal [[Hethra Mcgrrrr/Legends|Hethra Mcgrrrr]]<ref name="SWAJ11" /> as the '''Mcgrrrr Gang''', the pirate gang changed leadership frequently, with former leaders often meeting a [[Death/Legends|grisly end]].<ref name="Starhoppers" />

==History==
The gang purchased the twin dancers [[Amaiza Foxtrain/Legends|Amaiza]] and [[Jodelle Foxtrain]] from the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Quatrain Pudundruh]]. After Jodelle was accidentally killed during a raid, Amaiza became determined to learn how to defend herself. She quickly became popular among the pirates. The leader at the time, [[Kayso]], kept much of the pirates' spoils to himself. When this was discovered, Amaiza killed him and became the leader.<ref name="Starhoppers" /> The gang was dispersed shortly after this when the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Ripclaw (Imperial-class)|''Ripclaw'']] was dispatched to the Delphon system.<ref name="Unusual">{{GamerCite|6|Unusual Suspects}}</ref> Eventually the gang either joined up with or was absorbed by the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]].<ref name="Millenium Falcon" />
